'''Gamepasses'''
---- {{Notice |border = darkred |header = Gamepass Prices |top text = Gamepass and developer product prices are not the same for everyone. They can be higher or lower, generally up to a 70% reduction or increase. |bottom text = The wiki lists their base prices, though if the cost changes have been applied to majority or entirety of the playerbase, that cost is listed instead. }}
'''Gamepasses''' can be purchased with {{Robux|Robux}}. Some '''Gamepasses''' only give cosmetic changes, such as emotes or the ability to change the [[DJ Booth]]'s music, while others are gameplay changing, such as ability to gain level and exclusive towers. '''Gamepasses''' also occasionally have [[Sales]], which temporarily reduce their costs for a specific occasion, or bring back currently unavailable '''Gamepasses''' for a limited time.
==Price Changes== The costs listed here and the ones seen by the player on the Roblox site or the game itself may not be the same. This is due to the wiki listing the the base value of the price, which may not be the value used for certain players. This can happen for two reasons, either Roblox Plus, price optimization or regional pricing. ===Roblox Plus=== Players with the Roblox Plus subscription will have prices reduced by 10% or 20%, depending on how long they have subscribed to Roblox Plus for. ===Regional Pricing=== ''This is a brief overview of the Roblox feature. For more information, go [https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/monetization/regional-pricing here]. Certain gamepasses in Tower Defense Simulator have regional pricing applies to them. This will change the cost of the gamepass based on the player's region. If Roblox is unable to accurately determine the player's country, the base value is used instead. The cost of the gamepass will never go below 30% of the cost. ===Price Optimization=== ''This is a brief overview of the Roblox feature. For more information, go [https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/monetization/price-optimization here]. Tower Defense Simulator uses price optimization some time after '''Gamepasses''' and developer products are released. This means that subsets of players will receive different prices, generally varying from a 25% increase to a 25% decrease. This is not based on location, for example, two people in the same country can have different prices, one a 10% increase and the other a 25% decrease.
